eps.d: In an effort to become physically fit, Rocko and Heffer join a health club.
Rocko joins millions of cash-poor consumers when he gets a credit card.
Mrs. Bighead tries to win Rocko's affections.
Heffer moves in with Rocko.
Rocko experiences the thrills of traveling by plane.
Rocko decides that it's time to give Spunky a bath.
Mr. Bighead threatens to condemn Rocko's property if he doesn't clean up his yard.
Rocko is pulled over by the police because of a missing gas cap. His car is impounded, and to get it back he must suffer the unspeakable torment of the DMV.
Rocko manages the comic book store while his boss is on vacation.
Heffer has a near-death experience at the Chokey Chicken.

eps.t: The Good, the Bad, and the Wallaby
eps.d: Rocko and Heffer visit a dude ranch, where Heffer makes a few new friends.
Rocko decides to do some last-minute cleaning on trash day.
Rocko and Heffer attend a baseball game hoping to catch a foul ball.
Rocko and Heffer go see a movie.
Rocko gets suckered into buying a super-duper vacuum cleaner in an effort to clean his house.
Rocko loses his job at the comic store and must find a new one.
Rocko and Heffer go to a carnival and learn the secret to winning a carnival game.
Rocko and Spunky cool off on a hot summer day by spending a nice relaxing day at the beach.
The Bigheads take a trip to a mountain cabin for romance and relaxation, but are surprised to find Rocko and Heffer making the same trip for very different reasons.
Filburt asks Rocko to be his patient for his final dental exam.
Rocko and Spunky run to the local grocery store to take advantage of a big sale.
Rocko gets the flu and must be cured before the big wrestling match the next night.
Heffer invites Rocko to have dinner with his family.
Rocko appears on a dating show.
Spunky develops an unhealthy crush on Rocko's mop.
Rocko learns that laundry day can be very dangerous.
Rocko discovers that the Bigheads have a son, and he sets off to find him and bring him back.
When Rock's toilet is too clogged to flush, he and Heffer try to fix the problem themselves.
Rocko has to have his appendix removed.
Filburt realizes his dream of becoming a lounge singer.
After writing a proposal for her sick husband's presentation, Mrs. Bighead is hired as an executive at Conglomo-O
Rocko must take Spunky to the vet after he eats a vitamin that can cause pets to explode.
Rocko and Heffer go on a road trip to see Flemm Rock.
Rocko purchases a big screen television and Heffer loses his brain inside of it.
Rocko's car is impounded which causes him to continually be late for work.
Rocko invites everyone, including the Elves, over for Christmas, but Ed Bighead spreads rumors about the Elves, which ruins the party.
Rocko, Heffer and Filburt go camping.
With Rocko on the verge of being deported, Filburt poses as his spouse.
Heffer and Rocko say Bon Voyage to Heffer's Grandfather, who's going on a cruise vacation. When Heffer and Rocko miss the call to debark, they learn a little more respect for the eldery.
Filburt's 21st birthday approaches, and the ancient breeding ground of Kerplopitgoes calls.
Heffer gets a little taste of authority when he is hired as a security guard.
On the day he is supposed to pose for a newspaper photograph, Rocko is having a very bad hair day.
Ed Bighead's obsession with winning a bowling trophy has him disqualified from a bowling tournament..
Rocko needs to pay off the pizza man, so he organizes a garage sale.
After pulling overtime at his job, a housefly named Flecko disrupts Rocko's sleep.
On their way to deliver comic books, Rocko and Heffer are distracted by a ski resort.
Beverly adopts the neighborhoods stray dog, a vicious cur named Earl.
Feeling inadequate due to short stature, Really Really Big Man gives Rocko a vertical boost.
Rocko can't see without his new glasses, and they break just before the big jackhammer competition.
Heffer accidentally kills Filburt's pet bird, Turdy.
Heffer has a unique talent which embarrasses Heffer's father.
The story of the Chameleon Brothers and their coffee scandal in the old country of Balzack.
Heffer falls into a sausage-worshiping cult.
Filburt fights his fear of Halloween.
Rocko suspects Beverly of murdering Ed.
Rocko, Heffer and Filburt go on a fishing trip, unsuspecting that they are the prey.
Heffer and Filburt secretly video tape Rocko, and the movie turns into an underground hit, even winning an award at a film festival.
A mistake at the hospital endows Beverly with a nose, but the stench of her husband Ed is making her sick.
When Ed feels youth slipping away, he tries to become friends with Rocko, Heffer and Filburt.
Rocko's car breaks down, but Filburt can bring it back to life.
When Rocko helps the bugs escape from Ed's prison, they become unwelcome guests.

eps.t: I See London, I See France
eps.d: On a trip to France, Rocko falls in love.
Bloaty and Squirmy return, this time living on an obese Spunky, as Rocko tries to get Spunky to lose weight.
Every fortune cookie which Filburt opens predicts dire consequences for Filburt.
Rocko hires TV host Bob "Bucky" Taylor to repair his destroyed kitchen, but finds out that Bucky can only build bathrooms.
Heffer and Rocko appear on television after getting into an argument.
Rocko tries to overcome his nail-biting addition.

Ralph Bighead wants to leave the world of television animation, so he gives Rocko, Filburt and Heffer free rein in creating a new television show, hoping that their ineptitude will get Ralph's contract canceled.
The first part of a two-part episode has Filburt finally asking Doctor Hutchison to marry him.
A huge fight breaks out at the wedding, threatening Filburt and Hutch's marriage.
In order to be considered an adult, the Wolves tell Heffer to bring elk home for dinner, but ends up falling in love with it.
Rocko becomes a celebrity thanks to a little bit of spinach stuck in his teeth.
This musical-style episode has the Rocko pitting the town citizens against Conglom-O and their pollution.
Rocko becomes the owner of a possessed food processor.
Heffer and Filburt compete for Rocko's friendship after Rocko wins two tickets to a wrestling match.
Mr. Bighead, while sleepwalking, believes that he is a pirate and tries repeatedly to obtain a treasure map from Rocko.
Heffer suspects that he is being targeted for revenge after his practical jokes get out of hand.
Filburt and Hutch are expecting babies!
Rocko and Mr. Bighead run against each other for the office of Dog Catcher.
Ed's boss invites Ed to a game of golf. Ed is told to let Mr. Dupette win, but Heffer has other ideas.
Rocko prepares for a visit from grade-school bully, Dingo.
Filburt is ill, so Rocko and Heffer spin up some wild fairy tales to help him feel better.
Heffer moves out of his parent's place to prove he's capable of making it on his own.
After a visit to a spirit reader, Heffer is plagued by a spirit of his own.
Rocko tries to get a love letter back that was intended for his mail carrier.
Ed Bighead, under pressure at the job, turns to using a Magic 8-Ball to make executive decisions.
Ed Bighead has trouble accepting the fact that he enjoys being a clown.
Rocko and Heffer's friendship is strained when Rocko unwittingly finds fame as a high-fashion underwear model.
Rocko and Heffer think that Filburt is an alien who vaporizes Earthlings by high-fiving them.
Flecko the fly sues Rocko.
Heffer unknowingly trades his soul for an opportunity to be on a TV game show.
Falling in love with a roller-skater, Rocko tries to impress her by running a dangerous obstacle course.
Rocko is arrested after a game of Doorbell Ditch gets out of hand.
Filburt takes Rocko on a bird wig-snatching hunt.
Rocko thinks he's a dog after Heffer hypnotizes him.
Virginia Wolfe, Heffer's mother, asks Rocko to teach her to drive.

Heffer overdoses on Pasture Puffies (a snack food said to contain potentially harmful substances) and is rushed to the hospital. While he is in a coma, Rocko, Filburt, and the Bigheads reminisce about past experiences with the steer.
17 years into the future, Filburt's children ask Filburt the meaning of a banana which they found in a refrigerator.
Rocko tries to protect the Thanksgiving Turkeys that have taken refuge at his house.
The group spin tales about who really founded O-Town.
